races.name: Serpentine Last Friday of the Month 5K – October
races.venue: The Boathouse, Hyde Park, London W2
races.statusText: Online entry only · £7 affiliated / £9 unaffiliated · usually sells out a week before
races.why: Lunchtime two-lap 5K on a flat Hyde Park course run by Serpentine RTC – an easy central London PB chance.

races.name: Brighton 10K
races.why: Flat seafront out-and-back with a quick front end – one of the South East's best 10K PB courses.

races.name: Fulham 10K (Top Flight)
races.why: Closed-road, flat London 10K with a competitive front wave. Wave entry via OpenTrack code by email.

races.name: Friday Night Under the Lights 5K – November
races.statusText: Open to sub-16:15 men / sub-19:15 women via OpenTrack · elite races (sub-14:00 / sub-16:10) by email
races.why: Flat two-lap evening 5K in Battersea Park with seeded waves – only the elite races still have places.

races.name: Leeds Abbey Dash
races.why: England Athletics 10K Championships – a classic fast course with deep fields.

races.name: British Masters 5K Road Championships
races.statusText: Entries full · waiting list by email
races.why: BMAF championship 5K on the flat Battersea Park loop – masters age groups only.

races.name: Telford 10K
races.statusText: Waves 2–4 sold out · Wave 1 + elite open
races.why: Billed as the fastest 10K course in the UK – flat and traffic-free. Mass waves have gone; the fast wave is still open.

races.name: Ribble Valley 10K (Top Flight Finale)
races.why: Top Flight series finale with a competitive front field over the festive period.

races.name: FNUL x Podium x On New Year's Eve 5K & Mile
races.venue: Battersea Park Millennium Arena, London SW11
races.statusText: Sold out on OpenTrack · waiting list by email (5K standard sub-17:00 men / sub-19:30 women; mile sub-7:30)
races.why: Flat, fast Battersea Park 5K plus an open mile on New Year's Eve, chip-timed with seeded races and elite fields.

races.name: BMAF Indoor 3000m & Open Events
races.why: Masters indoor meeting with a 3000m and open track events – masters age groups only.

races.name: Armagh International 5K
races.statusText: Dated · entry by application, not open registration
races.why: Elite-heavy flat 5K circuit billed as one of the world's fastest road races, with a 3K alongside. Entry is restricted, so check how to apply before planning.

races.name: Hampton Court Half Marathon 2027
races.statusText: Early-bird entries open until end Oct · pacers · measured flat course
races.why: Predominantly flat Thames-side half, measured by an Olympic course measurer, with pacers and a 1:08:49 course record.

races.name: BMAF Indoor Championships
races.why: British Masters indoor championships (20–21 Feb), normally including 1500m and 3000m – masters age groups only.

races.name: FNUL 5K – February
races.why: Seeded evening 5K on a flat two-lap Battersea Park course with waves of up to 85.

races.name: Trafford 10K
races.statusText: Entries open · £28 club / £30 non-club · historically sells out early
races.why: One of the UK's fastest 10K courses with deep club fields – historically sells out.

races.name: FNUL 5K – March
races.why: Seeded evening 5K on a flat two-lap Battersea Park course with waves of up to 85.

races.name: Paddock Wood Half Marathon 2027
races.why: Fast, accurately measured UKA-licensed Kent half with pacers from 1:20 to 2:45.

races.name: Podium 5K – Leicester
races.why: Graded 5K and mile races with capped fields. Entries usually open on OpenTrack about three months out and sell out fast.

races.name: Ranelagh Half Marathon
races.why: Chip-timed riverside half through Ham and Richmond to Kingston Bridge and back, a short trip from south London.

races.name: Westminster Mile 2027
races.statusText: Entries open via Let's Do This
races.why: Central London road mile on The Mall with a BMC wave for fast runners.

races.name: FNUL New Year's Eve 5K 2027
races.why: Seeded New Year's Eve 5K on the flat two-lap Battersea Park course, the same format as the FNUL series.
